ITEM 1 | White, opaque, soft mound with pale cream-to-white color and slight speckling of black pepper flecks; lumpy, irregular, holds rough shape with rough crumbly-fluffy surface and visible curds; sits on the left and center of the plate covering roughly 35% of the plate, about 10 cm across and 3 cm tall at its peak | 150
ITEM 2 | Cubed golden-brown pieces with crisp, browned, slightly crusty exterior and pale interior edges; matte surface with light specks of seasoning; roughly 2.5 cm cubes, clustered on the right side of the plate covering about 25% of the plate, stacked up to about 2 cm high | 120
